external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A tenant company using the invoicing service.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
external_entities.notes: Each customer company is one tenant.

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can open the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users, handling invoices, payment pages, PDF requests, and database access.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it checks invoice company ownership or role authorization on request. It uses one database account for all companies and one service credential for all PDF bucket access.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by the job.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The billing app applies the company filter; the database has no row-level security. Protection at rest was not recorded.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket containing rendered PDFs stored under company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. Protection at rest was not recorded.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app, including viewing and editing invoices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; no second factor
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, and session information

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: query invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and writes tenant data in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice edits

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a PDF render job on the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using the company ID and invoice number from the job

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Support agent account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and actions performed as that user

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The boundary of a customer company's tenant and users.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform in which the shared billing app, database, and PDF bucket operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app is internet-facing because customer users and payers access it from outside the service's cloud platform.
assumptions.basis: Customer users use the billing app and payers can open its payment page, while the application runs in the cloud platform.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing invoice and bank-detail information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the renderer writes invoice PDFs to the PDF bucket, and the payment page displays invoices and bank details.
